column1: # The languages of each region in cloud/regions.tsv (one row per registry id;
# tests/test_region_languages.py checks that every registry row has one).
# languages = the languages of the region, comma-separated ISO 639 codes
# (ISO 639-1 where there is one), largest first. Largest means the most
# speakers, first and second language together, living in what the region's
# ZIM covers: its outline where cloud/region-outlines.tsv clips it, else its
# whole box, neighbours included (central-asia's box reaches Beijing and
# Delhi, so zh and hi lead it). Counts are rough (census and Ethnologue
# orders of magnitude). The list holds every national or official language
# of a country in the region, and other languages with millions of speakers
# docs/language-ready.md) records the row in map-config.json as
# regionLanguages; the viewer reads it for label order.
